newsitem.title: UK: Van Gogh's Harvest in Provence raises 8.8 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Van Gogh's Harvest in Provence raises 8.8 mln stg.

text.p: A painting by Vincent van Gogh was sold to a mystery buyer for a record 8.8 million pounds ($14.7 million) on Tuesday.
"Harvest in Provence" watercolour -- painted in 1888 -- was the most expensive painting to have been sold in London for seven years, Britain's Daily Telegraph said.
"It's van Gogh absolutely at his best," the director of auctioneers Sotheby's Holdings Inc told Sky News. The picture had been in a British private collection since 1924.
The bidder was widely reported to be an American, whose bid was made by telephone. REUTER AS ($ = 0.599 British Pounds)
